title: Fee refund policy

display_messages.content:
**Fee‑Refund Policy – at a glance** | Situation | What you get back | When & how it’s processed | |-----------|-------------------|---------------------------| | **Security Deposit (₹ 5,000)** | Fully refunded **on completion of the programme** or **on withdrawal** (after you obtain a **No‑Dues Certificate**). | The Institute may deduct a small amount for any damage or disciplinary fines that have been formally notified. | | **Withdrawal **_before_** classes start** | Tuition fee is **refunded** as per the University & State‑Level Fee Committee guidelines. | The refund request must be complete (all required forms & supporting documents). Processing takes **45‑60 working days** from the date of submission. | | **Withdrawal **_after_** classes have begun** | **No tuition‑fee refund** – the seat is considered filled and the fee is non‑refundable. | N/A (refund not applicable). | | **Cancellation of admission by the Institute (disciplinary grounds)** | Refund (if any) is **at the Director’s discretion** and follows University rules. | The security deposit may be **partially or fully forfeited** depending on the nature of the violation. | | **Late‑payment penalties** (if you miss the fee‑due date) | Not a refund, but a **penalty** you must pay before any refund can be processed. | • 1‑15 days late: ₹ 500 / day
• 16‑30 days late: ₹ 1,000 / day
• 31‑45 days late: ₹ 2,000 / day | | **General note** | All refunds are issued **only after the Institute receives the complete refund application** and any pending dues are cleared. | Payments are made by **Demand Draft** only (no cash or online transfers). Keep the DD receipt as proof. | ### How to apply for a refund 1. **Obtain a No‑Dues Certificate** from the Institute (clear all library, lab, hostel, etc., dues). 2. **Fill out the official refund application form** (available at the Institute’s admin office or website). 3. Attach **required documents** (copy of DD receipt, ID proof, No‑Dues Certificate, etc.). 4. Submit the complete packet to the Institute’s Finance/Administration office. > **Tip:** Submit the application as early as possible. Since processing takes up to two months, an early submission helps you get the money back sooner and avoids any inconvenience. If you have any specific doubts (e.g., “Can I get a partial tuition refund if I withdraw two weeks before classes?”) feel free to ask, and I’ll walk you through the exact steps!

Here’s the lineup for **today (Tuesday)**:

| Time          | Subject            | Location   | Instructor |
|---------------|--------------------|------------|------------|
| 9:00 – 10:00  | DBMS               | Room 102   | Dr. Verma |
| 10:00 – 11:00 | Mathematics        | Room 101   | Dr. Sharma |
| 11:00 – 12:00 | Programming Lab    | Lab‑1      | Ms. Gupta |
| 12:00 – 13:00 | **Lunch break**    | —          | — |
| 13:00 – 14:00 | Web Technologies   | Room 105   | Mr. Kumar |
| 14:00 – 15:00 | Computer Networks  | Room 103   | Mr. Yadav |

That’s everything scheduled for today. Have a great day of learning!
